label: UNMISS deployment present
aggregation: 1 if any UNMISS deployment location in county during year
notes: Base/team-site level, not patrol coverage. 2025 from Jan 2025 deployment map.

label: UNMISS troops deployed (est.)
aggregation: sum of Geo-PKO troop estimates at county locations, mean over the year's map timepoints
notes: Geo-PKO estimates troop numbers from unit sizes on UN maps (approximate). 2025 = Oct 2024 values for locations still shown on the Jan 2025 map. UNPOL/FPU police strength not fully included.
